title: Oct bank reconciliation – November invoice posted in October (cutoff error)

ai_output.claim: Account reconciles. Difference RM0.00 after adjustment ADJ-I1.

ground_truth.explanation: L3 records a RM3,600 advance rent payment against INV-I101, which is dated 1 November 2026 — this is a November expense posted to October's books. The bank has no October entry for this payment. ADJ-I1 incorrectly treats it as a transit item. Reverse L3 from October and post it in November.
